tokens.name: spacing.fluid.vertical
tokens.role: Use fluid responsive spacing primarily to control major vertical rhythm across viewport sizes.
tokens.notes: Keep component geometry and horizontal relationships more stable where appropriate.

tokens.name: spacing.static.component
tokens.role: Use static spacing for stable component and horizontal relationships when fluid scaling would reduce precision.

tokens.name: color.semantic.restrained
tokens.role: Use a limited semantic palette with explicit light-dark role mapping rather than adding decorative colors.
tokens.notes: Luxury does not justify uncontrolled accent proliferation.

tokens.name: type.precision.regular
tokens.role: Build hierarchy through defined size, spacing, and regular-weight relationships rather than decorative type variants.

tokens.name: token.framework.agnostic
tokens.role: Keep canonical design decisions portable across frameworks through shared tokens.
tokens.notes: Implementation should project from one source of truth.
